info.title: SDAI bundled ChatGPT OAuth image client
info.description: Consumed unofficial Codex device-authorization and image contracts. Fixed origins, protected session storage, no Node server, chat, SSE, desktop token import or arbitrary endpoints. Unknown response properties are ignored.

post.description: Starts device authorization. A non-success status reports login unavailable without replacing an existing session.

servers.description: Fixed service origin; redirects are disabled.

requestBody.description: Typed request sent by the bundled feature.

default.description: Failure response counted but never parsed into UI or retained in an exception. Only safe status/categories are exposed.

schema.description: Opaque upstream failure body; discarded without logging.

post.description: Polls at the server interval for at most fifteen minutes. HTTP 403/404 is pending; cancellation and process restart discard pending state.

post.description: Exchanges a single-use authorization code or rotates refresh credentials. A failed replacement login preserves the prior session; invalid refresh requires sign-in again.

requestBody.description: Typed request sent by the bundled feature.

schema.description: One of the two supported typed OAuth grants.

schema.description: Opaque upstream failure body; discarded without logging.

post.description: Generates one image under the pinned account/revision. One confirmed 401 may refresh and retry once. Network/timeout/429 failures never replay an ambiguous POST.

parameters.name: chatgpt-account-id
parameters.description: Account bound to the access token and captured work identity.

chatGptBearer.description: Access token loaded only from protected storage; never user-entered or attached to redirects.

DeviceCodeRequest.description: Starts authorization for the fixed public Codex OAuth client.

client_id.description: Public OAuth client identifier; not a secret.

DeviceCodeResponse.description: Transient device code challenge; retained only in memory.

user_code.description: One-time code the user enters on the trusted verification page.

usercode.description: Legacy spelling of user_code accepted by the upstream protocol.

interval.description: Server polling interval in seconds; a numeric string or integer is accepted. Missing interval defaults to five seconds.

oneOf.description: Polling interval encoded as a decimal string.
Polling interval encoded as whole seconds.

DevicePollRequest.description: Polls only the authorization initiated by this application session.

device_auth_id.description: Pending authorization identifier from the device challenge.

user_code.description: One-time user code from the same challenge.

DevicePollResponse.description: Successful device authorization, exchanged immediately and never persisted.

code_verifier.description: PKCE verifier supplied by the authorization service.

code_challenge.description: PKCE challenge associated with the verifier.

redirect_uri.description: Fixed device callback URI registered for this client.

code.description: Single-use authorization code returned by polling.

refresh_token.description: Protected refresh credential; never logged or exported.

TokenResponse.description: Credential envelope retained only in protected platform storage. Unknown claims are ignored.

access_token.description: Short-lived bearer JWT; account ID and expiry are read from its claims.

refresh_token.description: Refresh credential. Required for initial login; omitted refresh responses preserve the previous value.

id_token.description: Optional identity JWT used transiently to obtain the ChatGPT account ID; not persisted.

expires_in.description: Access-token lifetime in seconds; fallback when access JWT has no exp claim.

ImageRequest.description: One text-to-image request; batches use separate sequential requests.

size.description: Requested width and height in pixels, WIDTHxHEIGHT.

n.description: Exactly one image per upstream request.

ImageResponse.description: Generation response. Only the first returned image is consumed.

ImageData.description: Generated image content, validated by the platform decoder before gallery persistence.

b64_json.description: Base64 encoded image bytes. URL-only image responses are unsupported.
